root_cause: During actual authorized canonical bg-externe-signalen invocation 12486 (2026-10-25 09:23 UTC), Tavily quota blocked its source and one of three DataForSEO fallbacks returned DATAFORSEO_REMOTE_FAILURE. Two topics succeeded and one failed; the old DataForSEO code conflated transient HTTP/provider errors with non-retryable account, quota, validation and no-result outcomes.
fix: Use one canonical edge function and one bounded retry of a DataForSEO call only for documented temporary transport/HTTP 5xx and retryable provider task errors. Do not retry billing, auth, rate-limit, credit or input errors. Confirmed 40102 no results is a real empty SERP. Record previous and new observations in same Brain lineage, never invent a success.
prevention_rules: Classify provider errors before retrying; one retry maximum per failed DataForSEO topic and no extra scheduler or queue.
Never retry subscriptions, billing, credential or rate-limit errors as a way to hide red status.
Preserve provider-specific real-source references and independent, date-stamped quality checks; zero results is not an order.
Only raise to PROVEN after Required+CodeQL, protected merge, exact production edge readback and actual new invocation response.
terminal_rule: Exact-head Required and CodeQL; protected merge; published Supabase function files and version; actual pg_net readback. A genuinely non-retryable provider failure remains DEGRADED, not false green.
